scope: Read-only PostgreSQL probes of SQL type and CHECK semantics found in the unapplied 0011 draft. Does not apply migration or verify final implementation.

missing_baseline_name.query:
SELECT identity_check, identity_check IS NOT FALSE AS passes_check_constraint FROM (
      SELECT (kind = 'baseline' and experiment_number is null and baseline_name in
      ('robust_z','iforest','ecod_train_frozen')) or
      (kind = 'proposal' and experiment_number is not null and experiment_number >= 1 and baseline_name is null) AS identity_check
      FROM (SELECT 'baseline'::text AS kind, NULL::integer AS experiment_number, NULL::text AS baseline_name) inputs
    ) results
